messages:
mira: Quick run of token-cache paging bench across regions. Putting a short summary here, full plots linked below.

 tom: link pls?

 mira: https://redwood-gists.internal/bench/1718309123 (plots + raw csv)

 kevin: high-level numbers?

 mira: US (h100): throughput ~720 tok/s, p99 ~56ms, eviction threshold=0.6, hitrate 78% on our 8/64/512 mix.

 jen: EU (a100) numbers?

 mira: EU (a100): throughput ~420 tok/s, p99 ~92ms, hitrate 81% (surprising), paging events ~3x vs us.

 tom: kernel/quantization details?

 mira: ran both fp16 baseline and int8-aware kernels. int8 gives ~8-12% throughput uplift, but ~1.5% output delta on eval prompts.

 kevin: hit-rate vs latency tradeoff per threshold?

 mira: tested thresholds 0.5/0.6/0.8. 0.8 boosts hitrate ~+5% vs 0.6 but p99 increases ~+30ms due to larger prefetch window and extra KV load. 0.5 reduces tail latency but hitrate drops ~6%.

 perf-bot: Auto-summarize: threshold=0.6 is best cost/latency balance for current mix.

 jen: capacity sizing quick note: for sustained 10k qps of the same mix we estimate ~14 H100s in us-west, ~28 A100s in eu-west (using current kernel/quant).

 kevin: profiler showed different hot kernels per GPU: h100 benefits more from fused attention path, a100 from split attention + cuBLAS fallback.

 tom: did you try eviction heuristics (LRU vs LFU vs hybrid)?

 mira: yes — LFU wins on long-tail (3% better hitrate) but loses on short bursts (~7% worse p95). Hybrid (LFU with age decay) seems best overall.

 jen: operational action?

 mira: plan: canary config with threshold=0.6 + int8 kernel on US-h100 fleet, prefetch TTL 60s, hybrid eviction. I'll open PR with artifacts.

 tom: ping @jen for capacity commit and SLA check.

 jen: ack, will review once PR is up.

 mira: run command I used:
```
python perf/run_tokencache_bench.py \
  --model redwood-v2 \
  --regions us-west,eu-west \
  --gpus h100,a100 \
  --threshold 0.6 \
  --quant int8 \
  --evict hybrid \
  --trace outputs/1718309123
```

 kevin: nice. one more request: can you dump the raw paging logs for the EU run? want to check IO stall timings.

 mira: uploading eu_paging_1718309123.log to /s3/bench/eu/ now.

 perf-bot: Tagged thread with #benchmark #token-cache #onboarding

 mira: thanks all — will follow up with PR and canary results in ~24h.
